verdict.rationale: Plan-based usage and concurrency limits are a fair question for a hosted agent service like Devin, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents viewing or managing daily task quotas, concurrency caps, or plan-tier limits. Running multiple Devins in parallel is a related capability, not visibility into or control of limits, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
